summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for TPS613221ADBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5, boost): evaluated 22 same-category OPNs and shortlisted the top 9 ranked replacements (0 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 0 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 9 Level 3 Layout Change). Verify pinout, thermal margin, lifecycle status, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

selection_checklist: Confirm topology (boost, synchronous), pinout, and exposed thermal pad (None) on SOT-23-5.
Re-verify switching frequency (1600 kHz), inductor value (2.2 µH), and inductor Isat margin (>= 25% above peak switch current).
Check feedback reference Vref (Fixed internal divider) and recalculate R1/R2 divider plus feedforward cap before power-up.
Audit hot-loop ceramic input/output capacitance placement and thermal dissipation at worst-case Vin and ambient temperature.
